title: Revenue lookup plus facet report
behavior: revenue report joins orders to customers via $lookup let/pipeline and returns by_tier, by_month and 5 largest in single $facet with double-to-cents conversion

title: Empty join and empty facet branch
behavior: empty join preserves outer doc with [] and empty facet branch returns [] with double-to-cents conversion and zero counts

title: Inventory lookup with pipeline filter
behavior: products join inventory via $lookup localField foreignField plus pipeline $lt filter with cents conversion and facet grouping

title: Running total and sequence via $setWindowFields
behavior: Customer timeline running_total with documents unbounded to current and order_seq with $documentNumber partitioned by customer_id ordered by placed_at; cancelled and other-customer docs must be excluded by $match

title: 90-day rolling sum via range window
behavior: Customer timeline 90-day rolling sum with $sum range [-90,current] unit day partitioned by customer ordered by placed_at; includes double total conversion via $cond $type $round

title: Previous order date via $shift
behavior: Customer timeline previous order date with $shift by -1 partitioned by customer ordered by placed_at; first order must yield null

title: filtered positional refund and all-positional review
behavior: mark only the requested order lines as refunded with a filtered positional update guarded by line_id list and refund_status none | mark every order line as reviewed in a single update using the all-positional $[] operator

title: filtered positional with two identifiers and all-positional review
behavior: mark only requested order lines as refunded with filtered positional $[line] guarded by line_id $in list and refund_status none; mark every line reviewed with all-positional $[]

title: filtered positional and all-positional item updates
behavior: mark only requested order lines as refunded with filtered positional $[line] guarded by line_id list and refund_status none, and mark every line reviewed with all-positional $[]

title: Abort rolls back multi-line reservations and order
behavior: checkout must atomically reserve inventory for all lines, insert the order, and convert the cart in one transaction, rolling back all reservations if any line is out of stock or the order insert fails

title: Commit atomically persists reservations order and cart
behavior: checkout must atomically reserve inventory for all lines, insert the order, and convert the cart in one transaction, persisting all three only on commit

title: Uncommitted reservation invisible outside transaction
behavior: uncommitted checkout reservation must not be visible outside the transaction but must be visible inside, and abort must restore the original stock

title: Change stream filtered to update and replace only
behavior: Change stream with $match filter to update/replace only delivers updates and replaces while suppressing inserts

title: Change stream fullDocument updateLookup on update
behavior: Change stream with fullDocument updateLookup returns the post-update document for update operations

title: Change stream one event per change with non-blocking poll
behavior: Change stream with non-blocking polling emits one event per update in order without loss and empty poll returns promptly

title: Case-insensitive email lookup with collation
behavior: customer lookup by email must match case-insensitively using collation strength 2

title: Case-insensitive unique email via collation index
behavior: customer email uniqueness is case-insensitive via collation index locale en strength 2

title: Collation controls case sensitivity of email match
behavior: email match without collation is case-sensitive and with collation strength 2 is case-insensitive

title: Partial unique allows missing coupon but rejects duplicate per customer
behavior: coupon_code uniqueness per customer is enforced only when coupon_code exists via partial unique index

title: Partial unique coupon allows same code for different customers
behavior: coupon_code uniqueness is per customer, same coupon_code for different customers is allowed

title: TTL expires only active carts at expires_at
behavior: active carts auto-delete at expires_at via TTL index limited to status active

title: $jsonSchema requires customer_id, status, items, total and placed_at on orders
behavior: orders enforces $jsonSchema with required customer_id, status, items, total, placed_at at level moderate; inserts missing a required field fail with 121 and only valid docs persist

title: $jsonSchema enum and minimum on orders status and total
behavior: orders $jsonSchema restricts status to pending/paid/shipped/cancelled and total to >=0; violating inserts fail with 121 and only valid doc persists

title: $jsonSchema bsonType on items and placed_at plus update validation on orders
behavior: orders $jsonSchema requires items as array and placed_at as date and validates updates to valid docs; violating inserts and updates fail with 121 while valid update succeeds

title: Text search weighted ranking with active filter
behavior: Active product keyword search uses $text with weighted text index (name:10, tags:5, description:1) and $meta textScore ranking; higher-weight field matches must rank first and inactive products must be filtered.

steps.command_ejson: {"insert":"products","documents":[{"_id":1,"active":true,"category":"jackets","description":"premium warm winter coat","name":"basic jacket","price":69,"tags":["outerwear","casual"]},{"_id":2,"active":true,"category":"jackets","description":"warm winter coat everyday","name":"basic jacket","price":79,"tags":["premium","casual"]},{"_id":3,"active":true,"category":"jackets","description":"warm winter coat everyday","name":"premium jacket","price":99,"tags":["outerwear","casual"]},{"_id":4,"active":false,"category":"jackets","description":"warm winter coat everyday","name":"premium jacket","price":99,"tags":["outerwear","casual"]}]}
steps.label: seed-products

title: Text search exclusion term with active filter
behavior: Product search supports $text exclusion terms (e.g. premium -jacket) combined with active:true filter and textScore sort; excluded-term documents must not match.

steps.command_ejson: {"insert":"products","documents":[{"_id":1,"active":true,"category":"jackets","description":"warm winter coat","name":"premium jacket","price":99,"tags":["outerwear"]},{"_id":2,"active":true,"category":"boots","description":"warm winter boots","name":"premium boots","price":89,"tags":["footwear"]},{"_id":3,"active":true,"category":"tees","description":"cotton tee","name":"basic tee","price":19,"tags":["sale"]},{"_id":4,"active":false,"category":"boots","description":"warm winter boots","name":"premium boots","price":89,"tags":["footwear"]}]}
steps.label: seed-products

title: Text search active products ranked by textScore
behavior: Keyword product search uses $text index over name, description and tags with weights and returns only active products sorted by textScore ranking.

steps.command_ejson: {"insert":"products","documents":[{"_id":1,"active":true,"category":"jackets","description":"warm winter coat","name":"premium jacket","price":99,"tags":["outerwear"]},{"_id":2,"active":true,"category":"jackets","description":"premium warm winter coat","name":"leather jacket","price":99,"tags":["outerwear"]},{"_id":3,"active":true,"category":"boots","description":"warm winter boots","name":"leather boots","price":89,"tags":["footwear"]},{"_id":4,"active":false,"category":"jackets","description":"warm winter coat","name":"premium jacket","price":99,"tags":["outerwear"]}]}
steps.label: seed-products

title: Cart upsert fetch convert discard with cents
behavior: Touching a cart atomically create-or-updates by _id via upsert while marking active; fetching uses plain find by customer_id and status active; converting updates status to converted with order_id by _id; discarding deletes only when _id is still active

title: Order compare-and-set status with history push, customer history pagination and open-orders listing
behavior: Order compare-and-set status with history push, customer history pagination and open-orders listing

title: Referral chain via $graphLookup with depth tracking
behavior: referral chain report recursively follows referred_by to _id in customers and collects ancestors as referrers with depth tracking
